speaker: alse_pinder
text: The board is up, sir. Gib is on the settle and will not be moved for a poet.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Gib may stay. You may sit. The loaf is a finger short of the notch, and it has been so since the turn of the year. I am not measuring it again to please a Sunday.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Threepence for the board, Mistress. I have it.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Threepence is the meal. Firing and washing are sixpence the week until Lady Day, and I am not taking them off this plate. Mark me.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: Is the paper on the desk to go to the Bell? I can take it if it is folded.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Nothing goes to the Bell. The sentence stays where it is. I do not yet know the day. I will not write a yes to be rid of the question.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Then leave it. A supper at the Burbages' is not an answer to a wife, and I am not sending Alse out with an unfolded leaf.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: I should like to see a supper. I should like better to see a play. Will there be boys at Greenwich?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am not taking a play to Greenwich. Derby has his own men, if that hall has any. I am taking my appetite.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Then eat while it is hot. If you will not eat it hot, I cannot promise to keep it patient.
